title: Live Coding: Advanced Generics
definition: The toughest tier of TS interview questions, usually requiring the implementation of advanced utility types from scratch using Mapped Types, Conditional Types, and `infer`.
simpleExplanation: The interviewer says: 'Don't use the built-in `Omit` utility. Write your own custom version of `Omit` from absolute scratch.'
realWorldExample: Writing a `DeepPartial<T>` utility that makes all properties, and all nested properties inside objects infinitely deep, optional.

advanced: Implement a `TupleToObject` type that converts an array like `['a', 'b']` to `{ a: 'a', b: 'b' }`.

answers.question: How to implement Pick from scratch?
answers.answer: `type MyPick<T, K extends keyof T> = { [P in K]: T[P] };`. It maps over the requested keys, and reaches into T to grab the corresponding value type.
